artworks.title: Various Figure Studies
artworks.medium: metalpoint heightened with white on ochre-prepared paper with borders by Vasari in brown ink
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a scene with figures and a detailed frame. The left side shows sketches of two figures in dynamic poses, while the right side features a seated figure holding a circular object, all within an elaborate frame. The left side includes at least two figures, one in a crouched or kneeling position with a flowing garment, and another with skeletal legs. The seated figure on the right holds a circular object and is outlined with loose strokes. The background contains loose sketches creating a sense of movement. The frame is detailed with scrollwork, floral motifs, and decorative patterns.

artworks.title: Dancing Putto Holding a Drapery
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a cherubic figure in a dynamic pose. The figure appears to be in motion, with one arm raised above the head and a slight twist in the torso. The cherub's facial features are abstract and stylized, and the hair is tousled and flowing. The figure is nude and stands within a lightly sketched rectangular border. The background is plain, with a few sketched rectangular forms along the border. The drawing is executed in monochromatic brown ink, with shading and cross-hatching adding depth to the figure.

artworks.title: An Angel Carrying a Torch
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: overall (maximum measurement): 20.6 x 13 cm (8 1/8 x 5 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: A winged angel wearing a long billowing robe and holding a torch balances or lands on their left foot, on our right, in this vertical drawing. Created with dark brown ink against cream-white paper, the person is sketchily drawn so some of the details are indistinct. The right foot, on our left, is raised behind the angel, who looks down in that direction. A wing stretches out above, making an arc to our left. The edge of a column and base lines the right edge of the paper. The background behind the angel is slate blue. The drawing with the angel has been cut out near its edges and affixed to a sheet the same blue. Some white clouds billow up around the angel's feet.

artworks.title: Two Angels Carrying Torches
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and brown wash on laid paper, pricked for transfer
artworks.dimensions: overall (maximum measurement): 17.5 x 12.6 cm (6 7/8 x 4 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a heraldic shield featuring an angelic figure. The drawing shows an angel with wings uplifted, holding a rod or scepter in one hand, while the other hand supports a heraldic shield decorated with designs. The background includes lightly sketched clouds. The composition is enclosed within architectural framing details and border lines, adding structure to the image. Light shading is used to highlight the figure's movement and expression.

artworks.title: Saint Roch between Saints Anthony Abbot and Catherine of Alexandria
artworks.medium: gouache and brown wash heightened with white on laid paper
artworks.description: Three individuals are depicted in ornate niche-like spaces framed by classical architectural elements. The person on the left has a long beard and is wearing a long, brown robe with a hood, holding a staff. In the center, a male figure with long dark hair, dressed in a blue garment and holding a cross, is supported by a large wooden staff. The figure on the right is dressed in a pale robe edged with gold, with a pink drape around the shoulders, long wavy hair, and a halo, holding a palm. Foliage design is atop the architectural framing. The background shows a pale blue sky with light clouds, green fields, and distant buildings to the right.

artworks.title: Standing Woman with Her Hands Clasped in Prayer
artworks.medium: metalpoint heightened with white on gray-prepared paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person from the knees up in a standing position with hands clasped together at chest level. The person has a serene facial expression and delicate features, with hair covered by draped fabric extending over the shoulders. They wear a long flowing garment. The background is a textured, neutral backdrop with sketch lines and shading, suggesting a single color or medium.

artworks.title: Two Draped Women Standing on Either Side of a Herm
artworks.medium: metalpoint heightened with white on light green-prepared paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch featuring three individuals. The central figure is a woman standing with her arms folded across her chest. She gazes to the left. She has medium-length hair, partially covered with a flowing garment resembling a headscarf or hood. She is dressed in draped fabric, typical of classical or historical attire. Beside her, there is a faint sketch of a male figure's head turned sideways, showing a strong nose and a beard. To the right, there's an outline of another male figure wearing a cap. The drawing contains no visible jewelry or objects. The background is plain, emphasizing the pencil work and shading of the figures. The composition suggests a study sketch focusing on the posture and clothing of the figures.

artworks.title: A Tavern Garden in Rosenheim
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor beer garden scene. The scene shows a group of individuals seated at long wooden tables beneath tall trees. The trees cast dappled shadows over the scene. Many figures are clustered together in conversation, drinks in hand. In the background, there is a building facade with small windows. The drawing conveys a sense of camaraderie and communal enjoyment of a shared outdoor space.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a man seated and slightly turned to his right. He has a bald head with hair on the sides, a thick mustache, neutral facial expression, and is holding an object under his left arm. He is dressed in a jacket over a shirt. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Erpingham Gate, Norwich
artworks.medium: pen and black ink, gray wash, and watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an architectural gateway leading into a courtyard, featuring a symmetrical view of a Gothic-style window and spire of a building in the distance. The view is straight-on, showing cobblestone paths and intricate carvings on the gateway. A man leans against the left wall, while a couple stands on the right. The detailed brushwork style highlights the architectural details with fine lines. The color palette includes muted tones of gray, beige, and light blues. Statues, ornamental details, and faint clouds are seen in the sky above the gateway.

artworks.title: Cosimo II, Grand Duke of Tuscany
artworks.description: This image is a portrait showing the upper half of a person's body. The person is in a seated position, facing slightly to the right while looking directly at the viewer. The individual has a long face with prominent eyes, a broad nose, and a full mouth. Their long, wavy hair cascades down past their shoulders. They are wearing armor that covers one shoulder and part of the chest, with a cloak or piece of fabric draped around. The person holds a baton in their right hand. The background features an intricately designed border with laurel leaves and decorative scrolls. Below the image, there is a plaque with text that reads: "FRANCISCVS AB ETRVRIA COSMI. II. MAGNI DVCIS ETRVRIAE F."

artworks.title: Sebastian Le Clerc
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper part of the body, from the chest upwards. The person, identified as Seb. Le Clerc, is positioned in a three-quarter view, looking slightly to the side. He has curly hair that cascades over his shoulders, framing his face. His facial features include a prominent nose and a neutral expression. He is wearing a dark garment with elaborate detailing, along with a white collar. The portrait is set within an oval frame, and below it is a decorative crest or emblem. The background consists of a textured pattern, contrasting with the smooth oval frame around the figure.

artworks.title: Pallas Athene in the Form of a Bird Leaving Nestor and Telemachus
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray and brown washes over graphite, heightened with white, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ivan E. Phillips in memory of Jacqueline Getty Phillips
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene featuring an owl and a group of individuals. The drawing depicts a classical architectural setting with grand, towering columns and an archway in the background. In the foreground, a group of figures are portrayed in dramatic poses. One figure is sitting on a chair, reaching upwards while another kneels nearby. Two other figures are gesturing toward the owl, and a small pedestal table with vases is visible. The use of chiaroscuro and fine lines outlines the detailed textures of clothing and architectural elements, giving the scene a somber and majestic atmosphere.

artworks.title: An Ancient Sacrifice
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash, heightened with white, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ivan E. Phillips in memory of Jacqueline Getty Phillips
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a ceremonial scene in a grand architectural setting. The drawing depicts an interior with large, ornate columns reminiscent of classical Roman or Greek architecture. The ceiling has intricate designs and a circular arrangement of decorative panels. In the foreground and mid-ground, there is a gathering around an altar or pedestal, upon which a flame burns. Several figures, robed in flowing garments, are gathered around this central point, possibly in the midst of a ritual involving offerings. The figures are holding various objects, including what looks to be a dish. The space feels grand and solemn, with an emphasis on tradition and ritual. The shading and linework suggest careful attention to detail and capture the grandeur of both the figures and the architecture surrounding them.

artworks.title: Mythological Composition with Chronos and Harpies [recto]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythological figures in a dynamic scene. The central figure holds a tall staff with an expressive stance. Wing-like shapes are behind the central figure. Below, smaller figures resembling cherubs or similar beings with wings are present. To the left, another figure is in a seated or reclining position. Soft, flowing lines and a reddish hue give the drawing a classical and elegant feel. The scene captures an energetic moment in time.

artworks.title: Study of Two Putti and a Draped Arm [verso]
artworks.description: The image features a pencil sketch focusing on two human figures, showing only their hands and part of an arm. On the left, a hand is extended with gracefully curved fingers. This hand appears to be emerging from flowing fabric. On the right, an arm is visible, bent at the elbow, with a hand resting on the upper arm. The lines are bold, capturing the anatomy of the hand with shading for volume and texture. There are no facial features or hair visible. The background is an aged paper surface with faint lines and discoloration.

artworks.title: The Storm
artworks.medium: charcoal heightened with white on tan wove paper mounted to board
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Hollis Taggart Galleries, Inc.
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a harbor scene with boats and figures. The horizon is near the top of the image, with clouds and hints of buildings and a lighthouse. The brushstrokes are bold and expressive, creating movement in the sails and water. The color palette is monochromatic, with black and brown tones on light brown paper. Closest are boats with figures, adding life to the scene. In the distance, larger ships and masts are softly shaded.

artworks.title: Setting the Bow-Net
artworks.artist: Peter Henry Emerson and T.F. Goodall
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed to image): 16.5 x 28.8 cm (6 1/2 x 11 5/16 in.)
page size: 28.2 x 40.7 cm (11 1/8 x 16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Harvey S. Shipley Miller and J. Randall Plummer, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a side view of a wooden rowboat on a calm body of water. Two individuals are in the boat - one adjusting fishing nets at the left end, and the other holding an oar on the right. The horizon is high, with reeds and trees along the water's edge. The photo is in black and white, creating a classic and timeless ambiance with smooth transitions between shadows and highlights. The grayscale tones emphasize the tranquility of the scene, with reflections of the boat and people mirrored on the water's surface.

artworks.title: A Broadman's Cottage
artworks.artist: Peter Henry Emerson and T.F. Goodall
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed to image): 22.8 x 29 cm (9 x 11 7/16 in.)
page size: 28.2 x 40.7 cm (11 1/8 x 16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Harvey S. Shipley Miller and J. Randall Plummer, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a waterside scene captured from a low angle, slightly elevated above the water. The horizon consists of a grassy and reed-filled bank with trees and a thatched-roof cottage in the background. The style is realistic in black and white, with detailed textures in the water, reeds, and trees. A person is seen in a small boat near the water's edge, navigating with a wooden pole. A larger sailboat is docked nearby, contributing to the tranquility of the setting. The color palette is monochrome with shades of gray and black and soft contrasts to highlight details in reflections on the water and sky. The sky is partly cloudy, diffusing light across the scene.

artworks.title: A Sailing Match at Horning
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed to image): 22.6 x 29.1 cm (8 7/8 x 11 7/16 in.)
page size: 28.2 x 40.7 cm (11 1/8 x 16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Harvey S. Shipley Miller and J. Randall Plummer, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a river with sailboats gliding through the calm water. Lush, tree-lined banks merge with the horizon in the distance. The sailboats have billowing sails and are spread out across the water. The closest sailboat is on the right with figures on board. Other boats are further away, creating depth. The sky is overcast with a sepia tone. The color palette is subdued, giving a vintage quality. Soft, diffused clouds complement the tranquil atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Village of Horning
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed to image): 22.1 x 16.6 cm (8 11/16 x 6 9/16 in.)
page size: 40.7 x 28.2 cm (16 x 11 1/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Harvey S. Shipley Miller and J. Randall Plummer, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing on the bank of a narrow waterway, looking towards two sailboats gliding on calm water. In the background, there is a cluster of houses suggesting a village, with trees interspersed. The larger sailboat fills the left side of the image, with another boat seen in the distance. The reflection of the sails is mirrored in the water, conveying stillness. The image is in black and white, emphasizing shades of grey for a vintage atmosphere focused on form and light.

artworks.title: An Eel-Catcher's Home
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed to image): 20.4 x 28.9 cm (8 1/16 x 11 3/8 in.)
page size: 28.2 x 40.7 cm (11 1/8 x 16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Harvey S. Shipley Miller and J. Randall Plummer, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing on a small boat with a large net. Beside him is a larger boat resembling a house. Tall grasses and reeds are visible in the distance under a cloudy sky. The scene is reflected in the calm water.

artworks.title: Taking Up the Eel-Net
artworks.artist: Peter Henry Emerson and T.F. Goodall
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed to image): 18.8 x 28.2 cm (7 3/8 x 11 1/8 in.)
page size: 28.2 x 40.7 cm (11 1/8 x 16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Harvey S. Shipley Miller and J. Randall Plummer, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing in shallow water next to a small wooden boat, handling fishing nets. The background features distant trees, a cloudy sky, and two small structures or boats on the horizon. The overall color scheme is muted in sepia tones, giving the image a vintage appearance. The contrast between the dark clothing of the men and the lighter tones of the water and sky, with soft lighting, creates a serene and industrious atmosphere.
